data.content_ref: inline:Maintain carriage-closure as an explicit invariant that expands the edge set the grounded semantics sees without touching the fixpoint algorithm: whenever an artifact carries a warrant naming a target, every attacker of the carrier becomes an attacker of the warrant, enforced at att-construction time (0974daebd1665965, 0378275f89478d38). Because closure is a deterministic, linear-time expansion of the attack relation, the existing fixed point is unchanged and determinism, polynomial cost, reinstatement-as-derived, and root validity all survive verbatim. The criticizable claim: closure can manufacture self-attack cycles that newly refute previously accepted carriers, and the rule must be shown to be confluent — independent of the order in which edges are added — or it introduces an order-dependence into the committed edge set.
